harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured firewalld on node1 (RHEL 10) with a persistent public-zone policy that permits only SSH and TCP/8080 and rejects all other inbound traffic (target=DROP), then restarted the node and confirmed the policy, firewalld, and sshd all survived the reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/firewall tooling: RHEL 10.0, firewalld active+enabled, sudo -n available
Captured baseline firewalld state (public zone had ssh, cockpit, dhcpv6-client allowed, target=default)
Added --permanent ssh service and 8080/tcp port to public zone; set zone target to DROP
Removed extraneous permanent allowances (cockpit, dhcpv6-client) to satisfy 'reject unrelated inbound'
Reloaded firewalld and verified both permanent and runtime configs show services=ssh, ports=8080/tcp, target=DROP
Inspected live nft ruleset to confirm filter_IN_public_allow only accepts tcp dport 22 and 8080, with a reject-admin-prohibited catch-all
Ran temporary test listeners on 8080 and 9999 to sanity check (noted loopback-path curl test was inconclusive due to lo bypass; relied on nft ruleset as authoritative proof) and cleaned them up
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health of firewalld/sshd
Triggered a single non-destructive systemctl reboot of node1 via backgrounded ack-then-disconnect command
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed (636556ce... -> 3a6c3b2f...) proving an actual restart
Re-verified post-restart: firewalld active/enabled, target DROP, services=ssh, ports=8080/tcp persisted, sshd active and listening, nft allow-chain unchanged

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080, rejects unrelated inbound
evidence.summary: firewall-cmd --permanent config and live nft ruleset dump show public zone target=DROP with only tcp/22 and tcp/8080 accepted in filter_IN_public_allow, all other traffic hits reject-admin-prohibited
Both --permanent and runtime firewall-cmd --list-all outputs match (services=ssh, ports=8080/tcp, target=DROP) after firewall-cmd --reload
Captured boot_id 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d, firewalld running/active/enabled, sshd active, and the target rules in place before reboot
systemctl reboot was backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect; subsequent exec calls timed out confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 3a6c3b2f-c45e-42fb-ad23-80a8159135fa, differing from the pre-restart value, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of firewall and services
evidence.summary: After restart, firewalld is active/enabled with target=DROP and services=ssh/ports=8080/tcp persisted, nft filter_IN_public_allow chain still only allows tcp/22 and tcp/8080, and sshd is active and listening
